instruction: Enable the repeat/loop mode in VLC so the video plays continuously.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling loop/repeat mode in VLC. Agent can use Playback > Repeat One or keyboard shortcut 'L'. Custom getter checks <loop> element from VLC HTTP status.xml, metric compares boolean result.
metadata.verification: VLC loop mode: accessible via Playback menu or 'L' key. Getter extracts <loop> element from status.xml, returns boolean.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: loop/repeat mode enabled in VLC
Getter logic is sound: queries VLC HTTP status.xml, parses <loop> element, returns boolean with proper error handling
Metric logic is correct: simple boolean comparison with appropriate scoring (1.0 for match, 0.0 for mismatch)
Expected value is semantically correct: true represents loop mode enabled
Data flow is properly aligned: boolean extraction -> boolean comparison -> boolean expected
No postconfig needed: VLC remains running and status.xml is queryable at any time
Practical and feasible: VLC HTTP interface is standard in OSWorld environment
